here).\n\nauroc_within(stratum) = sum_s U_s / sum_s P_s where, inside stratum s, U_s counts ERROR x CORRECT pairs with the ERROR\nrow scored higher (ties 0.5) and P_s = n_err_s * n_cor_s. Stratum = one value for the pooled AUROC, template_id for the\nprimary statistic, sentence_id for the within-sentence robustness row.\n\nBootstrap weights: each replicate gives every sentence (cluster) an integer multiplicity k (sentences resampled with\nreplacement WITHIN each template). A row inherits the multiplicity of its sentence, so a pair (i, j) is weighted k_i*k_j\n(identical to physically duplicating the rows). For the within-sentence stratum a duplicated sentence is a duplicated\nstratum, so its pairs must count k (not k^2): rows then carry sqrt(k).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport numpy as np\n\n\nclass StratAUC:\n    \"\"\"Precomputes per-stratum score ranks once; value(cluster_weights) is then O(n) per replicate.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, score: np.ndarray, is_err: np.ndarray, stratum: np.ndarray, cluster: np.ndarray,\n                 stratum_is_cluster: bool = False):\n        score = np.asarray(score, dtype=float)\n        is_err = np.asarray(is_err, dtype=bool)\n        self.linear = stratum_is_cluster\n        self.parts = []\n        for s in np.unique(stratum):\n            m = stratum == s\n            y = is_err[m]\n            if y.all() or (~y).all():\n                continue\n            u, g = np.unique(score[m], return_inverse=True)\n            self.parts.append((g.astype(np.int64), y, cluster[m], len(u)))\n\n    def value(self, cw: np.ndarray | None = None) -> float:\n        U = P = 0.0\n        for g, y, cl, ng in self.parts:\n            if cw is None:\n                w = np.ones(len(g))\n            else:\n                w = cw[cl].astype(float)\n                if self.linear:\n                    w = np.sqrt(w)\n            negw = np.bincount(g[~y], w[~y], minlength=ng)\n            posw = np.bincount(g[y], w[y], minlength=ng)\n            below = np.cumsum(negw) - negw\n            U += float((posw * (below + 0.5 * negw)).sum())\n            P += float(posw.sum() * negw.sum())\n        return U / P if P > 0 else float(\"nan\")\n\n    def n_pairs(self) -> int:\n        return int(sum(int(y.sum()) * int((~y).sum()) for _, y, _, _ in self.parts))\n\n\ndef boot_weights(cluster_stratum: np.ndarray, B: int, seed: int) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"(B, n_clusters) integer multiplicities; clusters resampled with replacement within their stratum (template).\"\"\"\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    n = len(cluster_stratum)\n    W = np.zeros((B, n), dtype=np.int32)\n    groups = [np.flatnonzero(cluster_stratum == s) for s in np.unique(cluster_stratum)]\n    for b in range(B):\n        for idx in groups:\n            draw = rng.choice(idx, size=len(idx), replace=True)\n            np.add.at(W[b], draw, 1)\n    return W\n\n\ndef summarize(point: float, boots: np.ndarray) -> dict:\n    boots = boots[~np.isnan(boots)]\n    if len(boots) == 0:\n        return {\"est\": point, \"ci\": [None, None], \"se\": None, \"n_boot\": 0}\n    return {\"est\": point, \"ci\": [float(np.percentile(boots, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(boots, 97.5))],\n            \"se\": float(np.std(boots, ddof=1)), \"n_boot\": int(len(boots))}", "stderr": "\nShell cwd was reset to /ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_cNhUBrixEdz7/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper", "interrupted": false, "isImage": false, "noOutputExpected": false}

        import bisect
        for p in pos:
            lo=bisect.bisect_left(neg,p); hi=bisect.bisect_right(neg,p)

print(' orig n',len(fo),sum(x['y'] for x in fo),strat_auc(fo,'ca','y','t'),strat_auc(fo,'jo','y','t'))

# ---------- dev set E (exp 6 + eval 2) ----------
pe=jl(f'{X6}/results/per_item_T1.jsonl')
ev2=json.load(open(f'{EV2}/full_eval_out.json'))

pa=json.load(open(f'{EV2}/results/part_a.json'))
def findkey(o,k):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for kk,v in o.items():
            if kk==k: return v
            r=findkey(v,k)
            if r is not None: return r
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for v in o:
            r=findkey(v,k)
            if r is not None: return r

    x2=ev2rows.get(r['exp5_row_key'])
    sid=esids.setdefault(r['sentence_id'],len(esids))

      'ca':r6(r['c_score_align']),'pt':r6(r['p_peer_text']),'nf':r6(r['nf_c_score']),
      'jd':r6(r['judge_cheap_disg']),'jo':r6(r['judge_cheap_orig']),'jn':r6(r['judge_cheap2_disg']),'jq':r6(r['local__judge_local_qwen8b_disg']),
      'rt':r6(r['rt_nli_min']),'sc':r6(r['sc5_eq_frac']),

for k in ['ca','pt','nf','jd','jo','jn','jq','rt','sc']:

rr=[x for x in E if x['cx'] is not None]; print('  cx',len(rr),round(strat_auc(rr,'cx','y','st'),4))

for k,v in sorted(M4['k'].items(),key=lambda a:int(a[0])):

net=pa['NET']['R_AB']['words_T3_minus_T1']; print('NET',net['delta_e_plus_d'],net['ci'])

out={'sig_rows':sig,'sig_sents':sents,'free_rows':free,'e_rows':E,'kcurve':kc,'invariance':inv,

<!-- ============ THE FINDING ============ -->
<section class="block" id="finding" aria-labelledby="h-finding">
<div class="wrap grid2">
  <div class="prose">
    <div class="kicker">The finding</div>
    <h2 id="h-finding">Other models' translations can grade a formula</h2>
    <p class="q">Can you tell whether an LLM's <button class="term" type="button" data-term="fol">first-order logic</button> translation of a sentence is faithful when no gold formula exists?</p>
    <p>Ask several independent model families to translate the same sentence, check with the <button class="term" type="button" data-term="z3">Z3</button> solver which translations are logically equivalent, and score each candidate by the share of cross-family peers that disagree with it. That is the <button class="term" type="button" data-term="cscore">consensus score</button>. A correct translation tends to have company; a wrong one tends to stand alone.</p>
    <p>When the translators share a supplied predicate vocabulary (the <button class="term" type="button" data-term="sig">shared signature</button> condition), the score separates errors from correct translations almost perfectly on 221 long sentences with exception clauses, while a cheap LLM judge sits near chance. Under <button class="term" type="button" data-term="free">free vocabulary</button>, the lead survives but shrinks by roughly 0.15 <button class="term" type="button" data-term="auroc">AUROC</button>.</p>
    <div class="bignum" aria-live="polite">
      <div><div class="v m" id="big-m">&nbsp;</div><div class="l" id="big-ml">consensus</div></div>
      <div><div class="v b" id="big-b">&nbsp;</div><div class="l" id="big-bl">disguised judge</div></div>
      <div><div class="v" id="big-d">&nbsp;</div><div class="l">gap</div></div>
    </div>
    <p class="small muted">The three numbers are computed in your browser from the embedded per-translation records, for the condition selected on the right.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card" id="head-view">
    <p class="q" id="head-q">Does consensus beat the judges, and under which conditions?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="seg" role="tablist" aria-label="Vocabulary condition" id="head-tabs">
        <button role="tab" type="button" id="tab-sig" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="head-panel" data-reg="SIG">Shared signature</button>
        <button role="tab" type="button" id="tab-free" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="head-panel" data-reg="FREE" tabindex="-1">Free vocab, same sentences</button>
        <button role="tab" type="button" id="tab-e" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="head-panel" data-reg="E" tabindex="-1">Free vocab, dev set E</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="head-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-sig">
      <div class="controls">
        <label for="head-sub" id="head-sub-l">Sentence length</label>
        <select id="head-sub"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="chart" id="head-chart" role="figure" aria-label="AUROC by metric for the selected condition"></div>
      <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true">
        <span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Consensus (method)</span>
        <span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></i>LLM judges (baseline)</span>
        <span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--other)"></i>Other gold-free baselines</span>
      </div>
      <p class="note" id="head-note"></p>
    </div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="head-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

Every formula, class and score below is the run's recorded output.</p>

<!-- ============ TRY IT ============ -->
<section class="block" id="try" aria-labelledby="h-try">

  <p class="prose q">What if the peer pool were smaller, or the flagging threshold stricter?</p>
  <p class="prose">This recomputes the shared-signature consensus score for every translation in your browser, from the recorded Z3 equivalence classes: peers are the other-family translations of the same sentence that parsed; off-signature peers count as disagreeing. With every family in the pool the recomputation reproduces the recorded score exactly. Untick families to shrink the pool; drag the threshold to trade <button class="term" type="button" data-term="e">endorsement</button> for <button class="term" type="button" data-term="d">divergence</button>.</p>
  <div class="card">

<!-- ============ WHERE IT FAILS ============ -->
<section class="block" id="fails" aria-labelledby="h-fails">
<div class="wrap">
  <div class="kicker">Where it fails</div>
  <h2 id="h-fails">Long sentences, free vocabulary, renamed predicates</h2>

  <h3 id="h-ed">Divergence grows with length when vocabulary is free</h3>
  <p class="prose q">Why does the free-vocabulary score weaken on the sentences where gold-free evaluation matters most?</p>
  <p class="prose">Split each population into word-length terciles and count the two ways a majority vote of peers goes wrong: errors the majority endorses (<i>e</i>) and correct translations the majority rejects (<i>d</i>). At a binary threshold the AUROC equals 1 &minus; (<i>e</i> + <i>d</i>)/2.</p>
  <div class="controls">
    <div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Vocabulary condition" id="ed-reg">
      <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="SIG" tabindex="-1">Shared signature (R_COMP)</button>
      <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="true" data-v="E">Free vocabulary (dev set E)</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="chart" id="ed-chart" role="figure" aria-label="Endorsement and divergence rates by length tercile"></div>
  <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--err)"></i><i>e</i>: errors endorsed</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></i><i>d</i>: correct translations rejected</span></div>
  <p class="takeaway" id="ed-take" aria-live="polite"></p>

  <h3 style="margin-top:44px" id="h-ren">The rename tradeoff</h3>
  <p class="prose q">What happens when a correct formula is rewritten without changing its meaning?</p>
  <p class="prose">Under free vocabulary the <button class="term" type="button" data-term="aligner">predicate aligner</button> must match names across families. Rename the predicates of a correct formula and a name-based aligner loses its peers. The name-free variant <code>c_nf</code> is immune, but it cannot see errors that consist of a wrong predicate name.</p>
  <div class="controls">
    <label for="ren-rw">Meaning-preserving rewrite</label>
    <select id="ren-rw"></select>
  </div>
  <div class="chart" id="ren-chart" role="figure" aria-label="False-alarm rate per metric on the selected rewrite"></div>
  <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Consensus variants</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></i>Disguised judge</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--ink);width:3px"></i>False-alarm rate before the rewrite</span></div>
  <p class="takeaway" id="ren-take" aria-live="polite"></p>

  <h3 style="margin-top:44px">Consensus false alarms, one click away</h3>
  <p class="prose" id="fa-text"></p>
  <p><button type="button" class="btn primary" id="fa-open">Open consensus false alarms in the item browser</button></p>

  <h3 style="margin-top:36px">What the paper does not show</h3>
  <ul class="prose limits">
    <li><b>Confirmation is incomplete.</b> Held-out confirmation was budget-stopped. On the one testable stratum of the fresh set (short ProverQA sentences), consensus ties a local Qwen-8B judge (&Delta; = +0.003 [&minus;0.042, +0.052]); on 42 L25 items with 7 correct ones from 3 sentences it falls to 0.443.</li>
    <li><b>Shared-signature scope.</b> The 0.954 result uses templated sentences and a supplied vocabulary. It does not extend to translators that choose their own predicate names.</li>
    <li><b>Development overlap.</b> R_COMP-SIG later served as development data for aligner tuning, so the numbers on set E are not independent of it.</li>
    <li><b>Provisional free-vocabulary labels.</b> R_COMP FREE uses ERROR_CERT versus MAPPED, where MAPPED is an upper bound on correct; the labelling gate failed twice. The two-auditor subset gives &Delta; = +0.105 with a CI that barely excludes zero.</li>
    <li><b>Label dependence.</b> Set E labels come from a three-person panel with imperfect agreement; part of the advantage could reflect panel biases.</li>
    <li><b>Cost.</b> With nine peers the amortised consensus cost per candidate is about 19 times a single cheap judge call.</li>
    <li><b>Error typing.</b> Outside a shared vocabulary, typing the error is near chance: 0.123 accuracy on E, below the judge (0.326) and the peer-medoid baseline (0.328).</li>
    <li><b>Domain.</b> English to FOL only, from MALLS, ProverQA and R_COMP. Other formalisms and languages are untested.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
</section>
</main>

<!-- ============ FOOTER ============ -->
<footer id="notes" aria-labelledby="h-notes">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-notes">Links, data and glossary</h2>
  <div class="links" style="margin-bottom:26px">
    <a class="btn primary" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7/paper.pdf">Read the paper (PDF)</a>
    <a class="btn" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7/report.pdf">Read the full research report</a>
    <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7">Code repository</a>
  </div>
  <h3>Data provenance</h3>
  <p class="small muted">Each view reads one of the JSON blocks embedded in this page. Each block was produced by a script that reads the run's output files and keeps only the fields the views use; no value was typed by hand.</p>
  <ul class="prov" id="prov"></ul>
  <h3 style="margin-top:28px">Glossary</h3>
  <dl id="glossary">
    <dt>First-order logic (FOL)</dt><dd id="def-fol">The target language of the translation: formulas with quantifiers (&forall;, &exist;), predicates, connectives and negation. NL&rarr;FOL translation turns a natural-language sentence into such a formula.</dd>
    <dt>Z3</dt><dd id="def-z3">The SMT solver used to check whether two formulas are logically equivalent. Equivalent formulas fall in the same class.</dd>
    <dt>Consensus score (c_score)</dt><dd id="def-cscore">c_score(c, s) = 1 &minus; (1/k) &Sigma; 1[equiv(c, p<sub>i</sub>)]: the share of the k cross-family peer translations of sentence s that are not equivalent to candidate c. Higher means more likely an error.</dd>
    <dt>Shared signature (SIG)</dt><dd id="def-sig">All translators receive the same supplied predicate vocabulary, so equivalence is a direct Z3 check after case-insensitive symbol normalisation, and labels come from Z3 alone.</dd>
    <dt>Free vocabulary</dt><dd id="def-free">Each translator chooses its own predicate names, so comparing two formulas first needs a predicate-name aligner (c_score_align).</dd>
    <dt>AUROC</dt><dd id="def-auroc">The probability that a randomly chosen wrong translation receives a higher score than a randomly chosen correct one. 0.5 is chance, 1.0 is perfect separation.</dd>
    <dt>Within-template / stratified AUROC</dt><dd id="def-strat">AUROC that compares error and correct items only inside the same stratum (sentence template on R_COMP, source stratum on set E), removing confounds from stratum-level base rates.</dd>
    <dt>Disguised judge</dt><dd id="def-disg">An LLM judge that reads the sentence and candidate with nonce predicate names, to control for memorisation of known benchmarks. The original-view judge sees the real names.</dd>
    <dt>Endorsement e</dt><dd id="def-e">The fraction of ERROR items endorsed by the peer majority: the false negatives of consensus.</dd>
    <dt>Divergence d</dt><dd id="def-d">The fraction of CORRECT items that diverge from the peer majority: the false positives (false alarms) of consensus.</dd>
    <dt>Predicate aligner</dt><dd id="def-aligner">Under free vocabulary, maps predicate names across formulas using structural cost, text-anchor cost and truth-value signatures, then declares a pair equivalent if any of the cheapest bijections gives a Z3-verified equivalence.</dd>
    <dt>R_COMP</dt><dd id="def-rcomp">Long templated sentences (at least 25 words, 4 to 5 conditions, one unless / except / provided-that / only-if clause) built from a verified lexicon, with weak and strong reference readings trusted by construction.</dd>
    <dt>Weak and strong reading</dt><dd id="def-reading">The two accepted readings of an exception clause in R_COMP. For "A is B unless C" the weak reading is A &and; &not;C &rarr; B; the strong reading is A &rarr; (B &harr; &not;C).</dd>
    <dt>Development set E</dt><dd id="def-dsE">8,507 candidate translations of 700 MALLS and ProverQA sentences. Its primary population R_AB, where both panellists agree, has 2,686 items (1,822 ERROR / 864 CORRECT, 292 sentences).</dd>
    <dt>Nonce and synonym renames</dt><dd id="def-rename">Meaning-preserving rewrites of a correct formula: NONCE replaces predicate names with random nonsense names, SYN with WordNet synonyms. A metric should not change its verdict.</dd>
    <dt>False alarm (FA)</dt><dd id="def-fa">A correct translation that the metric flags as an error.</dd>
  </dl>
</div>
</footer>

<div class="tip" id="mark-tip" role="tooltip" hidden></div>
<div class="tip" id="term-tip" role="tooltip" hidden></div>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
/* ---------------- data ---------------- */
function readData(id){ return JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent); }
var SIG = readData("data-sig-rows");
var SENTS = readData("data-sig-sentences");
var FREE = readData("data-free-rows");
var EROWS = readData("data-e-rows");
var KC = readData("data-kcurve");
var INV = readData("data-invariance");
var ECUTS = readData("data-e-meta").tercile_cuts;

/* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */
var SVGNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
function sv(tag, attrs, parent){ var e=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,tag); if(attrs) for(var k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if(parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
function h(tag, attrs, html){ var e=document.createElement(tag); if(attrs) for(var k in attrs){ if(k==="text") e.textContent=attrs[k]; else e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); } if(html!=null) e.innerHTML=html; return e; }
function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){ return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]; }); }
function f3(x){ return (x==null||isNaN(x)) ? "n/a" : x.toFixed(3); }
function f2(x){ return (x==null||isNaN(x)) ? "n/a" : x.toFixed(2); }
function pct(x){ return (x==null||isNaN(x)) ? "n/a" : (100*x).toFixed(1)+"%"; }
function sgn(x){ return (x>=0?"+":"−")+Math.abs(x).toFixed(3); }
function fmtInt(n){ return n.toLocaleString("en-US"); }
function lowerBound(a,x){ var lo=0,hi=a.length; while(lo<hi){ var m=(lo+hi)>>1; if(a[m]<x) lo=m+1; else hi=m; } return lo; }
function upperBound(a,x){ var lo=0,hi=a.length; while(lo<hi){ var m=(lo+hi)>>1; if(a[m]<=x) lo=m+1; else hi=m; } return lo; }
/* stratified AUROC: sum_s U_s / sum_s P_s, ties count one half (same rule as the run's auc_tools.py) */
function stratAUC(rows, sf, yf, gf){
  var g = new Map(), nE=0, nC=0;
  rows.forEach(function(r){ var s=sf(r); if(s==null||isNaN(s)) return; var k=gf(r); var o=g.get(k); if(!o){ o={p:[],n:[]}; g.set(k,o); } if(yf(r)){ o.p.push(s); nE++; } else { o.n.push(s); nC++; } });
  var U=0,P=0;
  g.forEach(function(o){ if(!o.p.length||!o.n.length) return; o.n.sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}); o.p.forEach(function(p){ var lo=lowerBound(o.n,p), hi=upperBound(o.n,p); U+=lo+0.5*(hi-lo); }); P+=o.p.length*o.n.length; });
  return {auc: P? U/P : NaN, nE:nE, nC:nC, n:nE+nC};
}
function onResize(el, fn){ var w=0; if(window.ResizeObserver){ new ResizeObserver(function(){ var nw=el.clientWidth; if(nw!==w){ w=nw; fn(); } }).observe(el); } else { window.addEventListener("resize", fn); } }

/* ---------------- tooltips for chart marks ---------------- */
var markTip = $("mark-tip"), tipOwner=null;
function placeTip(tip, target){
  var r = target.getBoundingClientRect(); tip.hidden=false;
  var tw = tip.offsetWidth, th = tip.offsetHeight, vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  var x = r.left + r.width/2 - tw/2; x = Math.max(8, Math.min(vw - tw - 8, x));
  var y = r.top - th - 8; if(y < 8) y = r.bottom + 8;
  tip.style.left = x+"px"; tip.style.top = y+"px";
}
function showMark(el){ tipOwner=el; markTip.innerHTML = el.__tip; placeTip(markTip, el); }
function hideMark(){ markTip.hidden=true; tipOwner=null; }
function bindMark(el, html, label){
  el.__tip = html; el.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); el.setAttribute("role","img"); el.setAttribute("aria-label", label); el.classList.add("mark");
  el.addEventListener("mouseenter", function(){ showMark(el); });
  el.addEventListener("focus", function(){ showMark(el); });
  el.addEventListener("click", function(ev){ ev.stopPropagation(); showMark(el); });
  el.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideMark);
  el.addEventListener("blur", hideMark);
}
document.addEventListener("click", function(ev){ if(tipOwner && !tipOwner.contains(ev.target)) hideMark(); });
window.addEventListener("scroll", function(){ if(tipOwner) hideMark(); if(termOwner) closeTerm(); }, {passive:true});

/* ---------------- term tooltips ---------------- */
var termTip = $("term-tip"), termOwner=null;
function openTerm(btn){ var d=$("def-"+btn.dataset.term); if(!d) return; termOwner=btn; termTip.innerHTML = "<b>"+esc(btn.textContent)+"</b>: "+d.innerHTML; btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true"); placeTip(termTip, btn); }
function closeTerm(){ if(termOwner) termOwner.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); termTip.hidden=true; termOwner=null; }
document.querySelectorAll("button.term").forEach(function(b){
  b.setAttribute("aria-describedby","def-"+b.dataset.term); b.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");
  b.addEventListener("mouseenter", function(){ openTerm(b); });
  b.addEventListener("focus", function(){ openTerm(b); });
  b.addEventListener("click", function(ev){ ev.stopPropagation(); openTerm(b); });
  b.addEventListener("mouseleave", function(){ if(termOwner===b) closeTerm(); });
  b.addEventListener("blur", function(){ if(termOwner===b) closeTerm(); });
});
document.addEventListener("click", function(ev){ if(termOwner && ev.target!==termOwner && !termTip.contains(ev.target)) closeTerm(); });
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(ev){ if(ev.key==="Escape"){ closeTerm(); hideMark(); } });

/* ---------------- shared axis helpers ---------------- */
function niceTicks(lo, hi, step){ var t=[]; for(var v=lo; v<=hi+1e-9; v+=step) t.push(+v.toFixed(6)); return t; }

/* ---------------- labelled row sets ---------------- */
SIG.forEach(function(r,i){ r.i=i; r.t = SENTS[r.s].tpl; r.wt = SENTS[r.s].wt; });
var SIGL = SIG.filter(function(r){ return r.L==="E"||r.L==="C"; });
EROWS.forEach(function(r){ r.wt = r.w<=ECUTS[0] ? "T1" : (r.w<=ECUTS[1] ? "T2" : "T3"); });

/* =====================================================
   1. HEADLINE VIEW
   ===================================================== */
var REG = {
  SIG: { name:"shared signature (R_COMP-SIG)", subLabel:"Sentence length",
    subs:[["all","All 221 sentences"],["W1","Shortest tercile (W1)"],["W2","Middle tercile (W2)"],["W3","Longest tercile (W3)"]],
    rows:function(sub){ return SIGL.filter(function(r){ return sub==="all"||r.wt===sub; }); },
    y:function(r){ return r.L==="E"; }, g:function(r){ return r.t; }, strat:"template",
    metrics:[
      {k:"cs", name:"Consensus c_score_sig", grp:"m", frame:"jd"},
      {k:"jd", name:"Flash-lite judge, disguised", grp:"b"},
      {k:"jo", name:"Flash-lite judge, original view", grp:"b"},
      {k:"jl", name:"Local 8B judge, disguised", grp:"b"}],
    note:"Within-template AUROC. Consensus is scored on the rows the disguised judge also scored, as in the paper's primary test; each judge on the rows it scored. Labels: pure Z3 equivalence to the weak or strong reference." },
  FREE: { name:"free vocabulary on the same R_COMP sentences", subLabel:"Sentence length",
    subs:[["all","All sentences"],["W1","Shortest tercile (W1)"],["W2","Middle tercile (W2)"],["W3","Longest tercile (W3)"]],
    rows:function(sub){ return FREE.filter(function(r){ return sub==="all"||r.wt===sub; }); },
    y:function(r){ return r.y===1; }, g:function(r){ return r.t; }, strat:"template",
    metrics:[
      {k:"ca", name:"Consensus c_score_align", grp:"m", frame:"jd"},
      {k:"jd", name:"Flash-lite judge, disguised", grp:"b"},
      {k:"jo", name:"Flash-lite judge, original view", grp:"b"}],
    note:"Within-template AUROC on untouched rows under provisional, non-confirmatory labels (ERROR_CERT versus MAPPED). Consensus is scored on the disguised judge's rows." },
  E: { name:"free vocabulary on development set E (R_AB)", subLabel:"Source stratum",
    subs:[["all","All strata"],["L25","L25 (25+ words)"],["L20","L20 (20 to 24 words)"],["EXC","EXC (exception clauses)"],["CTRL","CTRL (short controls)"]],
    rows:function(sub){ return EROWS.filter(function(r){ return sub==="all"||r.st===sub; }); },
    y:function(r){ return r.y===1; }, g:function(r){ return r.st; }, strat:"source stratum",
    metrics:[
      {k:"pt", name:"p_peer_text (fused)", grp:"m"},
      {k:"ca", name:"Consensus c_score_align", grp:"m"},
      {k:"cx", name:"c_exact (no alignment)", grp:"m"},
      {k:"nf", name:"c_nf (name-free)", grp:"m"},
      {k:"jq", name:"Local Qwen-8B judge, disguised", grp:"b"},
      {k:"jn", name:"Nano judge, disguised", grp:"b"},
      {k:"jd", name:"Flash-lite judge, disguised", grp:"b"},
      {k:"jo", name:"Flash-lite judge, original view", grp:"b"},
      {k:"rt", name:"Round-trip NLI (min)", grp:"o"},
      {k:"sc", name:"Self-consistency (5 samples)", grp:"o"}],
    note:"Stratified AUROC across source strata; with a single stratum selected it is the plain AUROC inside it. Labels: panel verdicts where both panellists agree (R_AB)." }
};
var head = {reg:"SIG", sub:"all"};
function headCompute(){
  var R = REG[head.reg], rows = R.rows(head.sub);
  return R.metrics.map(function(m){
    var rr = rows.filter(function(r){ return r[m.k]!=null && (!m.frame || r[m.frame]!=null); });
    var a = stratAUC(rr, function(r){return r[m.k];}, R.y, R.g);
    return {m:m, auc:a.auc, nE:a.nE, nC:a.nC, n:a.n};
  });
}
function drawHBar(container, res, opts){
  container.innerHTML="";
  var W = Math.max(280, container.clientWidth), narrow = W < 520;
  var labW = narrow ? 0 : Math.min(250, W*0.38), rowH = narrow ? 50 : 30, top=8, bottom=40;
  var H = top + res.length*rowH + bottom, x0 = labW+8, x1 = W-46;
  var svg = sv("svg",{viewBox:"0 0 "+W+" "+H, width:W, height:H}, container);
  var X = function(v){ return x0 + (x1-x0)*v; };
  var ax = sv("g",{"class":"axis"},svg);
  niceTicks(0,1,0.1).forEach(function(t){
    sv("line",{x1:X(t),x2:X(t),y1:top,y2:H-bottom,"class":"gridl"},ax);
    if(!narrow || Math.round(t*10)%2===0){ var tx=sv("text",{x:X(t),y:H-bottom+16,"text-anchor":"middle"},ax); tx.textContent=t.toFixed(1); }
  });
  sv("line",{x1:X(0.5),x2:X(0.5),y1:top,y2:H-bottom,stroke:"#777","stroke-dasharray":"4 3"},svg);
  var cl=sv("text",{x:X(0.5)+4,y:top+10,"class":"lbl"},svg); cl.textContent="chance";
  var xl=sv("text",{x:(x0+x1)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl"},svg); xl.textContent=opts.xlabel;
  var col={m:"var(--accent)",b:"var(--base)",o:"var(--other)"};
  res.forEach(function(d,i){
    var y = top + i*rowH + (narrow? 20 : 5), bh = narrow ? 20 : rowH-10;
    if(narrow){ var t=sv("text",{x:x0,y:y-5,"class":"lbl"},svg); t.textContent=d.m.name; }
    else { var t2=sv("text",{x:labW,y:y+bh/2+4,"text-anchor":"end","class":"lbl"},svg); t2.textContent=d.m.name; }
    var v = isNaN(d.auc)?0:d.auc;
    var b = sv("rect",{x:X(0),y:y,width:Math.max(0,X(v)-X(0)),height:bh,rx:3,fill:col[d.m.grp]},svg);
    var vt=sv("text",{x:X(v)+5,y:y+bh/2+4,"class":"lbl","font-weight":"600"},svg); vt.textContent=f3(d.auc);
    bindMark(b, "<b>"+esc(d.m.name)+"</b><br>AUROC "+f3(d.auc)+"<br>n = "+fmtInt(d.n)+" ("+fmtInt(d.nE)+" errors / "+fmtInt(d.nC)+" correct)", d.m.name+": AUROC "+f3(d.auc)+", n "+d.n);
  });
}
function renderHead(){
  var R = REG[head.reg], res = headCompute();
  drawHBar($("head-chart"), res, {xlabel:"AUROC ("+(R.strat==="template"?"within template":"stratified by source stratum")+"; 0.5 = chance)"});
  var m = res.filter(function(d){ return d.m.k===(head.reg==="SIG"?"cs":"ca"); })[0];
  var b = res.filter(function(d){ return d.m.k==="jd"; })[0];
  $("big-m").textContent = f3(m.auc); $("big-b").textContent = f3(b.auc); $("big-d").textContent = sgn(m.auc-b.auc);
  $("big-ml").textContent = m.m.name.replace("Consensus ","consensus ");
  $("head-note").textContent = R.note;
  var subName = R.subs.filter(function(s){return s[0]===head.sub;})[0][1];
  var best = res.filter(function(d){return d.m.grp==="b";}).sort(function(a,c){return c.auc-a.auc;})[0];
  var t = "Under "+R.name+" ("+subName.toLowerCase()+", "+fmtInt(m.n)+" translations), consensus puts a random error above a random correct translation "+pct(m.auc)+" of the time; the disguised flash-lite judge does so "+pct(b.auc)+" of the time, a gap of "+sgn(m.auc-b.auc)+". ";
  if(best && best.m.k!=="jd") t += "The strongest judge here is the "+best.m.name.toLowerCase()+" at "+f3(best.auc)+". ";
  if(m.auc-best.auc < 0) t += "In this slice a judge beats consensus.";
  else if(m.auc - b.auc < 0.05) t += "The lead is small in this slice.";
  $("head-take").textContent = t;
}
function fillSub(){
  var R = REG[head.reg], sel=$("head-sub"); sel.innerHTML="";
  R.subs.forEach(function(s){ var o=h("option",{value:s[0],text:s[1]}); sel.appendChild(o); });
  $("head-sub-l").textContent = R.subLabel; head.sub="all";
}
function tabs(groupId, onSel){
  var btns = Array.prototype.slice.call($(groupId).querySelectorAll("button"));
  var isRadio = btns[0].getAttribute("role")==="radio", attr = isRadio ? "aria-checked":"aria-selected";
  function select(b, focus){
    btns.forEach(function(x){ var on = x===b; x.setAttribute(attr, on?"true":"false"); x.tabIndex = on?0:-1; });
    if(focus) b.focus(); onSel(b);
  }
  btns.forEach(function(b,i){
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){ select(b,false); });
    b.addEventListener("keydown", function(ev){
      var j=null; if(ev.key==="ArrowRight"||ev.key==="ArrowDown") j=(i+1)%btns.length; else if(ev.key==="ArrowLeft"||ev.key==="ArrowUp") j=(i-1+btns.length)%btns.length; else if(ev.key==="Home") j=0; else if(ev.key==="End") j=btns.length-1;
      if(j!=null){ ev.preventDefault(); select(btns[j], true); }
    });
  });
}
tabs("head-tabs", function(b){ head.reg=b.dataset.reg; $("head-panel").setAttribute("aria-labelledby", b.id); fillSub(); renderHead(); });
$("head-sub").addEventListener("change", function(){ head.sub=this.value; renderHead(); });
fillSub();
onResize($("head-chart"), renderHead);

/* =====================================================
   2. STEPPER
   ===================================================== */
var bySent = {}; SIG.forEach(function(r){ (bySent[r.s]=bySent[r.s]||[]).push(r); });
var SLOTORDER = ["G1","G1b","G2","G3","G4","G5","G6","G7","G8","G9"];
function sentRows(s){ return bySent[s].slice().sort(function(a,b){ return SLOTORDER.indexOf(a.sl)-SLOTORDER.indexOf(b.sl); }); }
function peersOf(r, pool){ return bySent[r.s].filter(function(p){ return p!==r && p.f!==r.f && p.L!=="U" && (!pool || pool.has(p.f)); }); }
function liveScore(r, pool){ if(r.cl==null) return null; var ps=peersOf(r,pool); if(!ps.length) return null; var ne=ps.filter(function(p){return p.cl===r.cl;}).length; return {c:1-ne/ps.length, ne:ne, np:ps.length, peers:ps}; }
var EXAMPLES = [["094cb4691a14","A clear majority, two isolated errors"],["0a06c603644e","Two readings split the correct translations"],["001a7f0caf5a","The first sentence of the set"]];
var sidIndex = {}; SENTS.forEach(function(s,i){ sidIndex[s.id]=i; });
EXAMPLES.forEach(function(e,i){ var s=SENTS[sidIndex[e[0]]]; $("step-ex").appendChild(h("option",{value:String(sidIndex[e[0]]),text:(i+1)+". "+e[1]+" ("+s.tpl+", "+s.words+" words)"})); });
var STAGES = [
  {n:"Sentence", t:"Sentence and shared signature"},
  {n:"Translate", t:"Ten translators write FOL"},
  {n:"Z3 classes", t:"Z3 groups equivalent formulas"},
  {n:"Score", t:"Score one candidate against its peers"},
  {n:"Evaluate", t:"Check against the reference (evaluation only)"}];
var st = {s: sidIndex[EXAMPLES[0][0]], stage:0, cand:null};
function symbolsOf(f){ var re=/([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\(([^()]*)\)/g, m, seen={}, out=[]; while((m=re.exec(f))){ var k=m[1]+"/"+m[2].split(",").length; if(!seen[k]){ seen[k]=1; out.push(k); } } return out; }
function labName(L){ return {E:"ERROR",C:"CORRECT",R:"READING CHOICE",O:"OFF SIGNATURE",U:"UNPARSEABLE"}[L]; }
function defaultCand(rows){ var e=rows.filter(function(r){return r.L==="E";})[0]; return e || rows[0]; }
function drawPipe(){
  var c=$("pipe"); c.innerHTML="";
  var W=760,H=64, n=STAGES.length, bw=118, gap=(W-n*bw)/(n-1);
  var svg=sv("svg",{viewBox:"0 0 "+W+" "+H,role:"presentation"},c);
  var defs=sv("defs",null,svg), mk=sv("marker",{id:"arr",viewBox:"0 0 10 10",refX:"9",refY:"5",markerWidth:"7",markerHeight:"7",orient:"auto"},defs); sv("path",{d:"M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z",fill:"#9a9ea5"},mk);
  STAGES.forEach(function(s,i){
    var x=i*(bw+gap), g=sv("g",{"class":"node"+(i===st.stage?" on":(i<st.stage?" done":""))},svg);
    sv("rect",{x:x+1,y:12,width:bw-2,height:40,rx:8,"stroke-dasharray": i===4?"5 3":null},g);
    var t=sv("text",{x:x+bw/2,y:37,"text-anchor":"middle"},g); t.textContent=(i+1)+". "+s.n;
    g.addEventListener("click", function(){ go(i); });
    if(i<n-1) sv("line",{x1:x+bw+3,y1:32,x2:x+bw+gap-4,y2:32,"class":"arrow","marker-end":"url(#arr)"},svg);
  });
}
function drawMarkers(){
  var ol=$("markers"); ol.innerHTML="";
  STAGES.forEach(function(s,i){ var li=h("li"); var b=h("button",{type:"button","aria-label":"Stage "+(i+1)+": "+s.t}); b.textContent=(i+1)+" "+s.n; if(i===st.stage) b.setAttribute("aria-current","step"); b.addEventListener("click", function(){ go(i); }); li.appendChild(b); ol.appendChild(li); });
}
function candList(rows, withCls){
  var ul=h("ul",{"class":"cands"});
  rows.forEach(function(r){ var li=h("li"); li.innerHTML='<span class="tag">'+esc(r.sl)+" "+esc(r.f)+'</span><div><div class="fol">'+esc(r.fol)+"</div>"+(withCls? '<span class="small muted">'+(r.cl? "class "+esc(r.cl) : (r.L==="U"?"did not parse":"uses symbols outside the signature"))+"</span>" :"")+"</div>"; ul.appendChild(li); });
  return ul;
}
function renderStage(){
  var rows=sentRows(st.s), S=SENTS[st.s], p=$("stage-panel"); p.innerHTML="";
  if(!st.cand || st.cand.s!==st.s) st.cand=defaultCand(rows);
  var io=h("div",{"class":"io"}), take="";
  function box(title, inner){ var c=h("div",{"class":"card"}); c.innerHTML="<h4>"+title+"</h4>"; if(typeof inner==="string") c.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", inner); else c.appendChild(inner); io.appendChild(c); return c; }
  p.appendChild(h("h3",{text:"Stage "+(st.stage+1)+" of 5: "+STAGES[st.stage].t}));
  if(st.stage===0){
    box("Goes in", "<p>"+esc(S.text)+"</p><p class='small muted'>Template "+esc(S.tpl)+", clause type "+esc(S.clause.replace(/_/g," "))+", "+S.words+" words, "+S.nc+" conditions.</p>");
    box("Done to it", "<p>Every translator receives the sentence together with the template's predicate signature, so all formulas use the same names.</p>");
    box("Comes out", "<p class='small'>Predicate symbols in the recorded reference readings:</p><div class='fol'>"+esc(symbolsOf(S.weak+" "+S.strong).join(", "))+"</div>");
    take="The sentence has "+S.words+" words and an exception clause ("+S.clause.replace(/_/g," ")+"); its "+symbolsOf(S.weak+" "+S.strong).length+" predicate symbols are fixed before anyone translates.";
  } else if(st.stage===1){
    box("Goes in", "<p>The sentence and the signature, sent with the same few-shot prompt to ten translator slots from different model vendors.</p>");
    box("Done to it", "<p>Each slot writes one formula. Nothing about the other slots is shown to it.</p>");
    var c=box("Comes out", "<p class='small'>"+rows.length+" formulas, "+rows.filter(function(r){return r.L==="U";}).length+" unparseable, "+rows.filter(function(r){return r.L==="O";}).length+" off-signature.</p>");
    p.appendChild(io); p.appendChild(candList(rows,false));
    var nd = new Set(rows.map(function(r){return r.fol.replace(/\s+/g,"");})).size;
    take="The ten slots produced "+nd+" textually distinct formulas. Text alone cannot say which of them mean the same thing; the solver can.";
    $("step-take").textContent=take; return;
  } else if(st.stage===2){
    var cls={}; rows.forEach(function(r){ var k=r.cl||"(none)"; (cls[k]=cls[k]||[]).push(r); });
    var keys=Object.keys(cls).sort(function(a,b){ return cls[b].length-cls[a].length; });
    box("Goes in", "<p>The "+rows.length+" formulas.</p>");
    box("Done to it", "<p>Z3 checks pairs of formulas for logical equivalence. Equivalent formulas share a class, however differently they are written.</p>");
    box("Comes out", "<p>"+keys.filter(function(k){return k!=="(none)";}).length+" equivalence classes; the largest holds "+cls[keys[0]].length+" formulas.</p>");
    p.appendChild(io);
    var grid=h("div",{"class":"classes"});
    keys.forEach(function(k){ var d=h("div",{"class":"cls"+(st.cand.cl===k?" sel":"")}); d.innerHTML="<h4>"+(k==="(none)"?"No class (unparseable or off-signature)":"Class "+esc(k)+" &middot; "+cls[k].length+" formula"+(cls[k].length>1?"s":""))+"</h4>"; d.appendChild(candList(cls[k],false)); grid.appendChild(d); });
    p.appendChild(grid);
    take="The biggest class holds "+cls[keys[0]].length+" of "+rows.length+" formulas. Formulas that differ only in bracketing or in how the exception is nested land together.";
    $("step-take").textContent=take; return;
  } else if(st.stage===3){
    var sel=h("select",{id:"cand-sel","aria-label":"Candidate to score"});
    rows.forEach(function(r){ var o=h("option",{value:String(r.i),text:r.sl+" "+r.f+(r.cl?" (class "+r.cl+")":" (no class)")}); if(r===st.cand) o.selected=true; sel.appendChild(o); });
    sel.addEventListener("change", function(){ st.cand=SIG[+this.value]; renderStage(); var s2=$("cand-sel"); if(s2) s2.focus(); });
    var lab=h("label",{"for":"cand-sel",text:"Candidate "}); var wrap=h("div",{"class":"controls"}); wrap.appendChild(lab); wrap.appendChild(sel); p.appendChild(wrap);
    var r=st.cand, ls=liveScore(r,null);
    box("Goes in", "<div class='fol'>"+esc(r.fol)+"</div><p class='small muted'>"+esc(r.sl)+", "+esc(r.sys)+"</p>");
    if(!ls){
      box("Done to it","<p>This formula has no equivalence class, so it cannot be scored. The run counts it as not scorable rather than dropping it silently.</p>");
      box("Comes out","<p>No score.</p>");
      p.appendChild(io); take="Unparseable and off-signature translations get no consensus score; they are reported in the coverage count."; $("step-take").textContent=take; return;
    }
    var ul='<ul class="peerlist">'+ls.peers.map(function(q){ var eq=q.cl===r.cl; return '<li class="'+(eq?"eq":"ne")+'">'+esc(q.sl)+" "+esc(q.f)+(eq?" = same class":" &ne; different")+"</li>"; }).join("")+"</ul>";
    box("Done to it", "<p>Peers are the other-family translations that parsed ("+ls.np+" here; the same-family slot is excluded). Count the peers in the candidate's class.</p>"+ul);
    box("Comes out", "<p class='formula'>c = 1 &minus; "+ls.ne+"/"+ls.np+" = <b>"+ls.c.toFixed(3)+"</b></p><p class='small'>Recorded by the run: "+r.cs.toFixed(3)+(Math.abs(r.cs-ls.c)<1e-5?" (match)":" (mismatch)")+"</p><p>"+(ls.c>=0.5?"<span class='tag flag'>Flagged</span> at the 0.5 threshold.":"<span class='tag'>Not flagged</span> at the 0.5 threshold.")+"</p>");
    p.appendChild(io);
    take=ls.ne+" of "+ls.np+" cross-family peers wrote a formula equivalent to this candidate, so its consensus score is "+ls.c.toFixed(3)+(ls.c>=0.5?" and it is flagged as a likely error.":" and it passes.");
    $("step-take").textContent=take; return;
  } else {
    var r2=st.cand, ls2=liveScore(r2,null);
    box("Goes in", "<p>The candidate and the two reference readings, which the metric never saw.</p><div class='fol'>"+esc(r2.fol)+"</div>");
    box("Done to it", "<p>Z3 compares the candidate with the weak and the strong reading. Equivalent to either means CORRECT.</p><h4 style='margin-top:8px'>Weak reading</h4><div class='fol'>"+esc(S.weak)+"</div><h4>Strong reading</h4><div class='fol'>"+esc(S.strong)+"</div>");
    box("Comes out", "<p><span class='tag "+r2.L+"'>"+labName(r2.L)+"</span>"+(r2.rd?" (matches the "+r2.rd+" reading)":"")+"</p><p class='small'>Consensus score: "+(ls2?ls2.c.toFixed(3):"n/a")+"<br>Disguised judge score: "+(r2.jd==null?"not scored":r2.jd.toFixed(2))+"<br>Original-view judge score: "+(r2.jo==null?"not scored":r2.jo.toFixed(2))+"</p><p class='small muted'>All scores are oriented so that higher means more likely an error.</p>");
    p.appendChild(io);
    var okC = ls2 && ((r2.L==="E" && ls2.c>=0.5) || (r2.L==="C" && ls2.c<0.5));
    var okJ = r2.jd!=null && ((r2.L==="E" && r2.jd>=0.5) || (r2.L==="C" && r2.jd<0.5));
    take = (r2.L==="E"||r2.L==="C") ? ("This translation is "+labName(r2.L)+". At a 0.5 threshold consensus is "+(okC?"right":"wrong")+" about it and the disguised judge is "+(r2.jd==null?"silent":(okJ?"right":"wrong"))+". "+(r2.L==="C"&&r2.rd==="strong"&&ls2&&ls2.c>=0.5?"It is a correct translation of the minority strong reading, the main source of consensus false alarms.":"")) : "This translation is not in the labelled ERROR/CORRECT population.";
    $("step-take").textContent=take; return;
  }
  p.appendChild(io); $("step-take").textContent=take;
}
function go(i){
  st.stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i));
  drawPipe(); drawMarkers(); renderStage();
  $("step-prev").disabled = st.stage===0; $("step-next").disabled = st.stage===STAGES.length-1;
  $("step-live").textContent = "Stage "+(st.stage+1)+" of "+STAGES.length+": "+STAGES[st.stage].t;
}
$("step-prev").addEventListener("click", function(){ go(st.stage-1); });
$("step-next").addEventListener("click", function(){ go(st.stage+1); });
$("stepper").addEventListener("keydown", function(ev){
  var tg=ev.target.tagName; if(tg==="SELECT"||tg==="INPUT") return;
  if(ev.key==="ArrowRight"){ ev.preventDefault(); go(st.stage+1); } else if(ev.key==="ArrowLeft"){ ev.preventDefault(); go(st.stage-1); }
});
$("step-ex").addEventListener("change", function(){ st.s=+this.value; st.cand=null; go(st.stage); });
go(0);

/* =====================================================
   3a. ITEM BROWSER
   ===================================================== */
var br = {q:"", lab:"all", view:"all", tpl:"all", sort:"cs", shown:60, sel:null};
var tpls = Array.from(new Set(SENTS.map(function(s){return s.tpl;}))).sort();
$("br-tpl").appendChild(h("option",{value:"all",text:"All templates"}));
tpls.forEach(function(t){ var cl=SENTS.filter(function(s){return s.tpl===t;})[0].clause.replace(/_/g," "); $("br-tpl").appendChild(h("option",{value:t,text:t+" ("+cl+")"})); });
function flagC(r){ return r.cs!=null && r.cs>=0.5; }
function flagJ(r){ return r.jd!=null && r.jd>=0.5; }
function brFilter(){
  var q=br.q.toLowerCase();
  return SIG.filter(function(r){
    if(br.lab!=="all"){ if(br.lab==="OU"){ if(r.L!=="O"&&r.L!=="U") return false; } else if(r.L!==br.lab) return false; }
    if(br.tpl!=="all" && r.t!==br.tpl) return false;
    if(br.view==="disagree"){ if(!(r.L==="E"||r.L==="C") || r.jd==null || r.cs==null || flagC(r)===flagJ(r)) return false; }
    if(br.view==="fa"){ if(!(r.L==="C" && flagC(r))) return false; }
    if(br.view==="jmiss"){ if(!(r.L==="E" && r.jd!=null && !flagJ(r))) return false; }
    if(br.view==="strong"){ if(!(r.L==="C" && r.rd==="strong")) return false; }
    if(q && SENTS[r.s].text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0 && r.fol.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0 && r.sys.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0) return false;
    return true;
  }).sort(function(a,b){
    function v(x,k){ return x[k]==null?-1:x[k]; }
    if(br.sort==="cs") return v(b,"cs")-v(a,"cs") || a.s-b.s;
    if(br.sort==="jd") return v(b,"jd")-v(a,"jd") || a.s-b.s;
    if(br.sort==="gap") return (v(b,"cs")-v(b,"jd"))-(v(a,"cs")-v(a,"jd")) || a.s-b.s;
    return a.t<b.t?-1:a.t>b.t?1:(a.s-b.s || SLOTORDER.indexOf(a.sl)-SLOTORDER.indexOf(b.sl));
  });
}
function scoreBar(label, v, color){
  var w = v==null?0:Math.round(v*100);
  return '<div class="scorebar"><span>'+label+'</span><span class="track" aria-hidden="true"><span class="fill" style="width:'+w+'%;background:'+color+'"></span><span class="thr"></span></span><b>'+(v==null?"n/a":v.toFixed(2))+'</b></div>';
}
function brDetail(r){
  var d=$("br-detail");
  if(!r){ d.innerHTML="<p class='muted'>No translation matches these filters.</p>"; return; }
  var S=SENTS[r.s], ls=liveScore(r,null);
  d.innerHTML = "<div class='meta' style='display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px'><span class='tag "+r.L+"'>"+labName(r.L)+"</span>"+(r.rd?"<span class='tag'>"+r.rd+" reading</span>":"")+"<span class='tag'>"+esc(S.tpl)+"</span><span class='tag'>"+esc(r.sl)+" "+esc(r.sys)+"</span></div>"+
    "<h4>Sentence (input)</h4><p style='font-size:.95rem'>"+esc(S.text)+"</p>"+
    "<h4>Candidate (translator output)</h4><div class='fol'>"+esc(r.fol)+"</div>"+
    "<div class='pair' style='margin-top:8px'><div><h4>Weak reading (reference)</h4><div class='fol'>"+esc(S.weak)+"</div></div><div><h4>Strong reading (reference)</h4><div class='fol'>"+esc(S.strong)+"</div></div></div>"+
    "<h4 style='margin-top:10px'>Scores (higher = more likely an error; tick = 0.5)</h4>"+
    scoreBar("Consensus", r.cs, "var(--accent)")+scoreBar("Judge, disguised", r.jd, "var(--base)")+scoreBar("Judge, original", r.jo, "var(--base)")+scoreBar("Local 8B judge", r.jl, "var(--other)")+
    "<p class='small' style='margin-top:8px'>"+(ls? ls.ne+" of "+ls.np+" cross-family peers are in this candidate's Z3 class.":"No consensus score: the formula "+(r.L==="U"?"did not parse.":"uses symbols outside the signature."))+"</p>";
}
function brRender(keepSel){
  var rows=brFilter(), ul=$("br-list"); ul.innerHTML="";
  if(!keepSel || rows.indexOf(br.sel)<0) br.sel = rows[0]||null;
  rows.slice(0, br.shown).forEach(function(r){
    var li=h("li"), b=h("button",{type:"button","aria-pressed": r===br.sel?"true":"false"});
    b.innerHTML="<span class='meta'><span class='tag "+r.L+"'>"+labName(r.L)+"</span><span class='small'>c "+(r.cs==null?"n/a":r.cs.toFixed(2))+" &middot; judge "+(r.jd==null?"n/a":r.jd.toFixed(2))+" &middot; "+esc(r.t)+" "+esc(r.sl)+"</span></span><span class='txt'>"+esc(r.fol)+"</span>";
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){ br.sel=r; Array.prototype.forEach.call(ul.querySelectorAll("button"), function(x){ x.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false"); }); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","true"); brDetail(r); });
    li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  $("br-more").hidden = rows.length<=br.shown;
  $("br-count").textContent = "Showing "+Math.min(br.shown,rows.length)+" of "+fmtInt(rows.length)+" matching translations.";
  brDetail(br.sel);
  var lab=rows.filter(function(r){return (r.L==="E"||r.L==="C");}), E=lab.filter(function(r){return r.L==="E";}), C=lab.filter(function(r){return r.L==="C";});
  var Ej=E.filter(function(r){return r.jd!=null;}), Cj=C.filter(function(r){return r.jd!=null;});
  var t="";
  if(!lab.length) t="None of the "+fmtInt(rows.length)+" matching translations is in the labelled ERROR/CORRECT population.";
  else {
    t="Of the "+fmtInt(rows.length)+" matching translations, "+fmtInt(E.length)+" are errors and "+fmtInt(C.length)+" are correct. ";
    if(E.length) t+="At a 0.5 threshold consensus flags "+pct(E.filter(flagC).length/E.length)+" of the errors"+(Ej.length?" and the disguised judge "+pct(Ej.filter(flagJ).length/Ej.length):"")+". ";
    if(C.length) t+="Consensus wrongly flags "+pct(C.filter(flagC).length/C.length)+" of the correct ones"+(Cj.length?", the judge "+pct(Cj.filter(flagJ).length/Cj.length):"")+".";
  }
  $("br-take").textContent=t;
}
$("br-q").addEventListener("input", function(){ br.q=this.value; br.shown=60; brRender(false); });
$("br-lab").addEventListener("change", function(){ br.lab=this.value; br.shown=60; brRender(false); });
$("br-view").addEventListener("change", function(){ br.view=this.value; br.shown=60; brRender(false); });
$("br-tpl").addEventListener("change", function(){ br.tpl=this.value; br.shown=60; brRender(false); });
$("br-sort").addEventListener("change", function(){ br.sort=this.value; brRender(false); });
$("br-more").addEventListener("click", function(){ br.shown+=60; brRender(true); });
brRender(false);

/* =====================================================
   3b. PER-TEMPLATE VIEW
   ===================================================== */
var tv = {reg:"SIG", cmp:"jd"};
var CMPNAME = {jd:"disguised flash-lite judge", jo:"original-view flash-lite judge", jl:"local 8B judge"};
function tplCompute(){
  var rows = tv.reg==="SIG" ? SIGL : FREE, mk = tv.reg==="SIG"?"cs":"ca", yf = tv.reg==="SIG" ? function(r){return r.L==="E";} : function(r){return r.y===1;};
  var cats = tpls.concat(["All"]);
  return cats.map(function(t){
    var rr = rows.filter(function(r){ return (t==="All"||r.t===t) && r[tv.cmp]!=null && r[mk]!=null; });
    var a = stratAUC(rr, function(r){return r[mk];}, yf, function(r){return r.t;});
    var b = stratAUC(rr, function(r){return r[tv.cmp];}, yf, function(r){return r.t;});
    return {t:t, a:a, b:b};
  });
}
function renderTpl(){
  var c=$("tpl-chart"); c.innerHTML="";
  var res=tplCompute(), W=Math.max(300,c.clientWidth), H=280, ml=40, mr=8, mt=12, mb=46;
  var svg=sv("svg",{viewBox:"0 0 "+W+" "+H,width:W,height:H},c);
  var Y=function(v){ return mt+(H-mt-mb)*(1-v); }, bw=(W-ml-mr)/res.length;
  var ax=sv("g",{"class":"axis"},svg);
  niceTicks(0,1,0.25).forEach(function(t){ sv("line",{x1:ml,x2:W-mr,y1:Y(t),y2:Y(t),"class":"gridl"},ax); var tx=sv("text",{x:ml-6,y:Y(t)+4,"text-anchor":"end"},ax); tx.textContent=t.toFixed(2); });
  sv("line",{x1:ml,x2:W-mr,y1:Y(0.5),y2:Y(0.5),stroke:"#777","stroke-dasharray":"4 3"},svg);
  var yl=sv("text",{x:12,y:(mt+H-mb)/2,transform:"rotate(-90 12 "+((mt+H-mb)/2)+")","text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl"},svg); yl.textContent="Within-template AUROC";
  var xl=sv("text",{x:(ml+W-mr)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl"},svg); xl.textContent="Sentence template";
  res.forEach(function(d,i){
    var x=ml+i*bw, inner=Math.min(22,(bw-6)/2);
    [[d.a,"var(--accent)","Consensus"],[d.b,"var(--base)",CMPNAME[tv.cmp]]].forEach(function(p,j){
      var v=isNaN(p[0].auc)?0:p[0].auc, rx=x+bw/2-inner+j*inner;
      var rect=sv("rect",{x:rx,y:Y(v),width:inner-2,height:Y(0)-Y(v),rx:2,fill:p[1]},svg);
      var cl = d.t==="All"?"all templates":(d.t+", "+SENTS.filter(function(s){return s.tpl===d.t;})[0].clause.replace(/_/g," "));
      bindMark(rect, "<b>"+esc(cl)+"</b><br>"+esc(p[2])+": AUROC "+f3(p[0].auc)+"<br>n = "+fmtInt(p[0].n)+" ("+p[0].nE+" errors / "+p[0].nC+" correct)", p[2]+" on "+cl+": "+f3(p[0].auc));
    });
    var tx=sv("text",{x:x+bw/2,y:H-mb+16,"text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl","font-weight":d.t==="All"?"700":"400"},svg); tx.textContent=d.t;
  });
  $("tpl-leg").textContent = CMPNAME[tv.cmp].charAt(0).toUpperCase()+CMPNAME[tv.cmp].slice(1);
  var per=res.filter(function(d){return d.t!=="All" && !isNaN(d.a.auc) && !isNaN(d.b.auc);});
  var wins=per.filter(function(d){return d.a.auc>d.b.auc;}).length;
  var gaps=per.map(function(d){return {t:d.t,g:d.a.auc-d.b.auc};}).sort(function(a,b){return a.g-b.g;});
  var all=res[res.length-1];
  $("tpl-take").textContent = (tv.reg==="SIG"?"Shared signature":"Free vocabulary (provisional labels)")+": consensus beats the "+CMPNAME[tv.cmp]+" in "+wins+" of "+per.length+" templates. The smallest gap is "+gaps[0].t+" ("+sgn(gaps[0].g)+"), the largest "+gaps[gaps.length-1].t+" ("+sgn(gaps[gaps.length-1].g)+"); over all templates "+f3(all.a.auc)+" against "+f3(all.b.auc)+" on "+fmtInt(all.a.n)+" paired rows.";
}
tabs("tpl-reg", function(b){ tv.reg=b.dataset.v; var s=$("tpl-cmp"); s.querySelector('option[value="jl"]').disabled = tv.reg==="FREE"; if(tv.reg==="FREE" && tv.cmp==="jl"){ tv.cmp="jd"; s.value="jd"; } renderTpl(); });
$("tpl-cmp").addEventListener("change", function(){ tv.cmp=this.value; renderTpl(); });
onResize($("tpl-chart"), renderTpl);

/* =====================================================
   3c. K-CURVE
   ===================================================== */
function renderK(){
  var c=$("k-chart"); c.innerHTML="";
  var W=Math.max(300,c.clientWidth), H=300, ml=46, mr=16, mt=14, mb=46, ks=KC.k;
  var lo=0.5, hi=0.85;
  var svg=sv("svg",{viewBox:"0 0 "+W+" "+H,width:W,height:H},c);
  var X=function(k){ return ml+(W-ml-mr)*(k-1)/(ks.length-1); }, Y=function(v){ return mt+(H-mt-mb)*(1-(v-lo)/(hi-lo)); };
  var ax=sv("g",{"class":"axis"},svg);
  niceTicks(0.5,0.85,0.05).forEach(function(t){ sv("line",{x1:ml,x2:W-mr,y1:Y(t),y2:Y(t),"class":"gridl"},ax); var tx=sv("text",{x:ml-6,y:Y(t)+4,"text-anchor":"end"},ax); tx.textContent=t.toFixed(2); });
  ks.forEach(function(d){ var tx=sv("text",{x:X(d.k),y:H-mb+16,"text-anchor":"middle"},ax); tx.textContent=d.k; });
  var yl=sv("text",{x:12,y:(mt+H-mb)/2,transform:"rotate(-90 12 "+((mt+H-mb)/2)+")","text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl"},svg); yl.textContent="AUROC (0.5 = chance)";
  var xl=sv("text",{x:(ml+W-mr)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl"},svg); xl.textContent="Number of peer families k";
  var series=[["all","All rows","var(--accent)",""],["T1","Shortest tercile","#6f9fd8","2 3"],["T2","Middle tercile","var(--other)","6 3"],["T3","Longest tercile","var(--err)","8 4"]];
  if($("k-all").checked){ var band="M"+ks.map(function(d){return X(d.k)+","+Y(d.ci[1]);}).join(" L")+" L"+ks.slice().reverse().map(function(d){return X(d.k)+","+Y(d.ci[0]);}).join(" L")+" Z"; sv("path",{d:band,fill:"var(--accent-soft)"},svg); }
  var shown=[];
  series.forEach(function(s){
    if(!$("k-"+s[0]).checked) return; shown.push(s);
    sv("path",{d:"M"+ks.map(function(d){return X(d.k)+","+Y(d[s[0]]);}).join(" L"),fill:"none",stroke:s[2],"stroke-width":2.5,"stroke-dasharray":s[3]},svg);
    ks.forEach(function(d){
      var pt=sv("circle",{cx:X(d.k),cy:Y(d[s[0]]),r:6,fill:"#fff",stroke:s[2],"stroke-width":2.5},svg);
      bindMark(pt, "<b>"+s[1]+", k = "+d.k+"</b><br>AUROC "+f3(d[s[0]])+(s[0]==="all"?"<br>95% CI ["+f3(d.ci[0])+", "+f3(d.ci[1])+"]":"")+"<br>"+pct(d[s[0]]/ks[ks.length-1][s[0]])+" of the k = "+ks[ks.length-1].k+" value", s[1]+" k "+d.k+": "+f3(d[s[0]]));
    });
    var last=ks[ks.length-1]; var lt=sv("text",{x:X(last.k)-4,y:Y(last[s[0]])-10,"text-anchor":"end","class":"lbl",fill:s[2]},svg); lt.textContent=s[1];
  });
  function k95(key){ var top=ks[ks.length-1][key]; for(var i=0;i<ks.length;i++) if(ks[i][key]>=0.95*top) return ks[i]; return ks[ks.length-1]; }
  if(!shown.length){ $("k-take").textContent="Tick a series to draw it."; return; }
  $("k-take").textContent = shown.map(function(s){ var k=k95(s[0]); return s[1]+": k = "+k.k+" families reach 95% of the k = "+ks[ks.length-1].k+" AUROC ("+f3(k[s[0]])+" of "+f3(ks[ks.length-1][s[0]])+")"; }).join("; ")+". Population: "+fmtInt(KC.n)+" candidates from "+KC.n_sent+" sentences with all "+ks[ks.length-1].k+" other families available.";
}
["k-all","k-T1","k-T2","k-T3"].forEach(function(id){ $(id).addEventListener("change", renderK); });
onResize($("k-chart"), renderK);

/* =====================================================
   4. TRY IT: live recomputation
   ===================================================== */
var FAMS = Array.from(new Set(SIG.map(function(r){return r.f;}))).sort();
var pool = new Set(FAMS);
FAMS.forEach(function(f){
  var n = new Set(SIG.filter(function(r){return r.f===f;}).map(function(r){return r.sl;})).size;
  var lab=h("label",{"class":"chk"}); var cb=h("input",{type:"checkbox",value:f}); cb.checked=true;
  cb.addEventListener("change", function(){ if(cb.checked) pool.add(f); else pool.delete(f); if(pool.size===0){ cb.checked=true; pool.add(f); } renderTry(); });
  lab.appendChild(cb); lab.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "+f+(n>1?" ("+n+" slots)":""))); $("fam-box").appendChild(lab);
});
function renderTry(){
  var thr=+$("thr").value; $("thr-out").textContent=thr.toFixed(2);
  var full = pool.size===FAMS.length;
  var scored=0, match=0;
  SIGL.forEach(function(r){ var ls=liveScore(r,pool); r._c = ls? ls.c : null; if(ls){ scored++; if(r.cs!=null && Math.abs(ls.c-r.cs)<1e-5) match++; } });
  var allScored=0, allMatch=0; if(full){ SIG.forEach(function(r){ var ls=liveScore(r,null); if(ls){ allScored++; if(Math.abs(ls.c-r.cs)<1e-5) allMatch++; } }); }
  $("try-check").textContent = full ? ("Recomputed "+fmtInt(allScored)+" consensus scores from the recorded classes; "+fmtInt(allMatch)+" equal the recorded c_score_sig.") : ("Pool: "+Array.from(pool).join(", ")+". "+fmtInt(scored)+" labelled translations still have at least one peer; "+fmtInt(SIGL.length-scored)+" have none and drop out.");
  var rows=SIGL.filter(function(r){return r._c!=null;});
  var E=rows.filter(function(r){return r.L==="E";}), C=rows.filter(function(r){return r.L==="C";});
  var rec=E.filter(function(r){return r._c>=thr;}).length/E.length, fa=C.filter(function(r){return r._c>=thr;}).length/C.length;
  var flagged=rows.filter(function(r){return r._c>=thr;}), prec = flagged.length? flagged.filter(function(r){return r.L==="E";}).length/flagged.length : NaN;
  var fr=rows.filter(function(r){return r.jd!=null;});
  var auc=stratAUC(fr,function(r){return r._c;},function(r){return r.L==="E";},function(r){return r.t;});
  var aj=stratAUC(fr,function(r){return r.jd;},function(r){return r.L==="E";},function(r){return r.t;});
  // judge at matched false-alarm rate: lowest judge threshold whose FA does not exceed consensus FA
  var jE=fr.filter(function(r){return r.L==="E";}).map(function(r){return r.jd;}), jC=fr.filter(function(r){return r.L==="C";}).map(function(r){return r.jd;});
  var cands=Array.from(new Set(jE.concat(jC))).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}); cands.push(Infinity);
  var jrec=0, jfa=0;
  for(var i=0;i<cands.length;i++){ var t=cands[i]; var f=jC.filter(function(v){return v>=t;}).length/jC.length; if(f<=fa+1e-12){ jrec=jE.filter(function(v){return v>=t;}).length/jE.length; jfa=f; break; } }
  var S=$("try-stats"); S.innerHTML="";
  [[f3(auc.auc),"Consensus within-template AUROC (judge rows, n "+fmtInt(auc.n)+")"],[f3(aj.auc),"Disguised judge AUROC, same rows"],[pct(rec),"Errors flagged (recall = 1 − e)"],[pct(fa),"Correct flagged (false alarms, d)"],[pct(prec),"Precision of a flag"],[pct(jrec),"Judge recall at a false-alarm rate ≤ "+pct(fa)]].forEach(function(s){ var d=h("div",{"class":"stat"}); d.innerHTML="<div class='v'>"+s[0]+"</div><div class='l'>"+s[1]+"</div>"; S.appendChild(d); });
  drawHist(E, C, thr);
  $("try-take").textContent = "With "+(full?"every family":pool.size+" of "+FAMS.length+" families")+" in the pool and a threshold of "+thr.toFixed(2)+", consensus catches "+pct(rec)+" of the "+fmtInt(E.length)+" errors while flagging "+pct(fa)+" of the "+fmtInt(C.length)+" correct translations; at the same false-alarm budget the disguised judge catches "+pct(jrec)+". Ranking quality: AUROC "+f3(auc.auc)+" against "+f3(aj.auc)+".";
}
function drawHist(E, C, thr){
  var c=$("try-chart"); c.innerHTML="";
  var W=Math.max(300,c.clientWidth), H=260, ml=46, mr=10, mt=12, mb=46, nb=10;
  function bins(rows){ var b=new Array(nb).fill(0); rows.forEach(function(r){ var k=Math.min(nb-1,Math.floor(r._c*nb+1e-9)); b[k]++; }); return b; }
  var bE=bins(E), bC=bins(C), mx=0; for(var i=0;i<nb;i++){ mx=Math.max(mx,bE[i]/E.length,bC[i]/C.length); }
  var top=Math.ceil(mx*10)/10;
  var svg=sv("svg",{viewBox:"0 0 "+W+" "+H,width:W,height:H},c);
  var X=function(v){ return ml+(W-ml-mr)*v; }, Y=function(v){ return mt+(H-mt-mb)*(1-v/top); };
  var ax=sv("g",{"class":"axis"},svg);
  niceTicks(0,top,top>0.5?0.2:0.1).forEach(function(t){ sv("line",{x1:ml,x2:W-mr,y1:Y(t),y2:Y(t),"class":"gridl"},ax); var tx=sv("text",{x:ml-6,y:Y(t)+4,"text-anchor":"end"},ax); tx.textContent=Math.round(t*100)+"%"; });
  niceTicks(0,1,0.2).forEach(function(t){ var tx=sv("text",{x:X(t),y:H-mb+16,"text-anchor":"middle"},ax); tx.textContent=t.toFixed(1); });
  var yl=sv("text",{x:12,y:(mt+H-mb)/2,transform:"rotate(-90 12 "+((mt+H-mb)/2)+")","text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl"},svg); yl.textContent="Share of class";
  var xl=sv("text",{x:(ml+W-mr)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","class":"lbl"},svg); xl.textContent="Consensus score (bins of 0.1; last bin includes 1.0)";
  var bw=(W-ml-mr)/nb;
  for(var k=0;k<nb;k++){
    [[bE[k],E.length,"var(--err)","errors"],[bC[k],C.length,"var(--cor)","correct translations"]].forEach(function(p,j){
      var v=p[0]/p[1], x=X(k/nb)+2+j*(bw-4)/2;
      var r=sv("rect",{x:x,y:Y(v),width:Math.max(1,(bw-4)/2-1),height:Y(0)-Y(v),fill:p[2]},svg);
      var lo=(k/nb).toFixed(1), hi=((k+1)/nb).toFixed(1);
      bindMark(r, "<b>Score "+lo+" to "+(k===nb-1?"1.0 inclusive":hi)+"</b><br>"+fmtInt(p[0])+" of "+fmtInt(p[1])+" "+p[3]+" ("+pct(v)+")", p[3]+" in bin "+lo+": "+p[0]);
    });
  }
  sv("line",{x1:X(thr),x2:X(thr),y1:mt-4,y2:H-mb,stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-width":2.5},svg);
  var tl=sv("text",{x:Math.min(X(thr)+5,W-80),y:mt+8,"class":"lbl","font-weight":"600"},svg); tl.textContent="flag ≥ "+thr.toFixed(2);

(max-width:600px){.pair{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.scorebar{grid-template-columns:100px minmax(0,1fr) 48px}}\n.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:10px 0}\n.stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;padding:8px
