(max-width:600px){body{font-size:17px}.wrap{padding:0 16px}section.block{padding:40px 0 30px}.card{padding:14px}}\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<a class=\"skip\" href=\"#main\">Skip to main content</a>\n\n<header class=\"top\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <div class=\"kicker\">Explorable companion to the paper</div>\n    <h1>Cross-Family Solver Consensus as a Gold-Free Faithfulness Metric for Natural-Language-to-First-Order-Logic Translation</h1>\n    <p class=\"author\">Anonymous</p>\n    <div class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</header>\n\n<nav class=\"sections\" aria-label=\"Sections\">\n  <ul>\n    <li><a href=\"#finding\">The finding</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#how\">How it works</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#evidence\">Explore the evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try it</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#notes\">Links and glossary</a></li>\n  </ul>\n</nav>\n\n<main id=\"main\" tabindex=\"-1\">\n\n<!-- ============ THE FINDING ============ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n<div class=\"wrap grid2\">\n  <div class=\"prose\">\n    <div class=\"kicker\">The finding</div>\n    <h2 id=\"h-finding\">Other models' translations can grade a formula</h2>\n    <p class=\"q\">Can you tell whether an LLM's <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"fol\">first-order logic</button> translation of a sentence is faithful when no gold formula exists?</p>\n    <p>Ask several independent model families to translate the same sentence, check with the <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"z3\">Z3</button> solver which translations are logically equivalent, and score each candidate by the share of cross-family peers that disagree with it. That is the <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"cscore\">consensus score</button>. A correct translation tends to have company; a wrong one tends to stand alone.</p>\n    <p>When the translators share a supplied predicate vocabulary (the <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"sig\">shared signature</button> condition), the score separates errors from correct translations almost perfectly on 221 long sentences with exception clauses, while a cheap LLM judge sits near chance. Under <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"free\">free vocabulary</button>, the lead survives but shrinks by roughly 0.15 <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"auroc\">AUROC</button>.</p>\n    <div class=\"bignum\" aria-live=\"polite\">\n      <div><div class=\"v m\" id=\"big-m\">&nbsp;</div><div class=\"l\" id=\"big-ml\">consensus</div></div>\n      <div><div class=\"v b\" id=\"big-b\">&nbsp;</div><div class=\"l\" id=\"big-bl\">disguised judge</div></div>\n      <div><div class=\"v\" id=\"big-d\">&nbsp;</div><div class=\"l\">gap</div></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"small muted\">The three numbers are computed in your browser from the embedded per-translation records, for the condition selected on the right.</p>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"head-view\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"head-q\">Does consensus beat the judges, and under which conditions?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Vocabulary condition\" id=\"head-tabs\">\n        <button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" id=\"tab-sig\" aria-selected=\"true\" aria-controls=\"head-panel\" data-reg=\"SIG\">Shared signature</button>\n        <button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" id=\"tab-free\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"head-panel\" data-reg=\"FREE\" tabindex=\"-1\">Free vocab, same sentences</button>\n        <button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" id=\"tab-e\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"head-panel\" data-reg=\"E\" tabindex=\"-1\">Free vocab, dev set E</button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div id=\"head-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-sig\">\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <label for=\"head-sub\" id=\"head-sub-l\">Sentence length</label>\n        <select id=\"head-sub\"></select>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"head-chart\" role=\"figure\" aria-label=\"AUROC by metric for the selected condition\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n        <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Consensus (method)</span>\n        <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>LLM judges (baseline)</span>\n        <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--other)\"></i>Other gold-free baselines</span>\n      </div>\n      <p class=\"note\" id=\"head-note\"></p>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"head-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============ HOW IT WORKS ============ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <div class=\"kicker\">How it works</div>\n  <h2 id=\"h-how\">One sentence through the pipeline</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose q\">What does the consensus score actually compute for a single translation?</p>\n  <p class=\"prose\">This walks one real <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"rcomp\">R_COMP</button> sentence from the shared-signature run through the four stages of the metric, plus the evaluation step that the metric never sees. Every formula, class and score below is the run's recorded output.</p>\n  <div class=\"controls\">\n    <label for=\"step-ex\">Example sentence</label>\n    <select id=\"step-ex\"></select>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"stepper card\" id=\"stepper\">\n    <div class=\"pipe\" id=\"pipe\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n    <ol class=\"markers\" id=\"markers\" aria-label=\"Stages\"></ol>\n    <div class=\"sr-only\" aria-live=\"polite\" id=\"step-live\"></div>\n    <div class=\"stage-panel\" id=\"stage-panel\" tabindex=\"-1\"></div>\n    <div class=\"stepnav\">\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"step-prev\">&larr; Previous</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"step-next\">Next &rarr;</button>\n      <span class=\"small muted\">Tip: the left and right arrow keys move between stages while the stepper has focus.</span>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"step-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============ EVIDENCE ============ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <div class=\"kicker\">Explore the evidence</div>\n  <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">Every translation, every template, every peer count</h2>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-browser\">Item browser</h3>\n  <p class=\"prose q\">What do the translations that consensus flags look like, next to the reference and the judge's verdict?</p>\n  <p class=\"prose\">All 2,210 shared-signature translations: 221 sentences times ten translator slots. Filter by verdict, look at the cases where consensus and the disguised judge disagree, and open any row to compare the candidate with both reference readings.</p>\n  <div class=\"controls\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Browser filters\">\n    <input type=\"search\" id=\"br-q\" placeholder=\"Search sentence or formula\" aria-label=\"Search sentence or formula\">\n    <label for=\"br-lab\">Verdict</label>\n    <select id=\"br-lab\">\n      <option value=\"all\">All translations</option>\n      <option value=\"E\">Errors</option>\n      <option value=\"C\">Correct</option>\n      <option value=\"R\">Reading choice</option>\n      <option value=\"OU\">Off-signature or unparseable</option>\n    </select>\n    <label for=\"br-view\">Show</label>\n    <select id=\"br-view\">\n      <option value=\"all\">Everything</option>\n      <option value=\"disagree\">Consensus and judge disagree</option>\n      <option value=\"fa\">Consensus false alarms</option>\n      <option value=\"jmiss\">Errors the judge misses</option>\n      <option value=\"strong\">Correct, strong reading</option>\n    </select>\n    <label for=\"br-tpl\">Template</label>\n    <select id=\"br-tpl\"></select>\n    <label for=\"br-sort\">Sort</label>\n    <select id=\"br-sort\">\n      <option value=\"cs\">Consensus score, high first</option>\n      <option value=\"jd\">Judge score, high first</option>\n      <option value=\"gap\">Consensus minus judge</option>\n      <option value=\"tpl\">Template, sentence</option>\n    </select>\n  </div>\n  <p class=\"small\" id=\"br-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  <div class=\"browser\">\n    <div>\n      <ul class=\"list\" id=\"br-list\" aria-label=\"Matching translations\"></ul>\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn\" id=\"br-more\" style=\"margin-top:8px\">Show more</button>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"card\" id=\"br-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n  </div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"br-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:44px\" id=\"h-tpl\">Template by template</h3>\n  <p class=\"prose q\">Does the gap hold for every sentence template, or does one template carry it?</p>\n  <div class=\"controls\">\n    <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Vocabulary condition\" id=\"tpl-reg\">\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"radio\" aria-checked=\"true\" data-v=\"SIG\">Shared signature</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"radio\" aria-checked=\"false\" data-v=\"FREE\" tabindex=\"-1\">Free vocabulary</button>\n    </div>\n    <label for=\"tpl-cmp\">Compare with</label>\n    <select id=\"tpl-cmp\">\n      <option value=\"jd\">Disguised flash-lite judge</option>\n      <option value=\"jo\">Original-view flash-lite judge</option>\n      <option value=\"jl\">Local 8B judge (disguised)</option>\n    </select>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"chart\" id=\"tpl-chart\" role=\"figure\" aria-label=\"Within-template AUROC per template\"></div>\n  <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Consensus</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i><span id=\"tpl-leg\">Judge</span></span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:none;border-top:2px dashed #777;height:0;border-radius:0\"></i>Chance (0.5)</span></div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tpl-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:44px\" id=\"h-k\">How many peer families?</h3>\n  <p class=\"prose q\">How many cross-family peers does the score need before it stops improving?</p>\n  <p class=\"prose\">On development set E, the run drew k other families at random (50 draws per row) and scored each candidate against only those peers. Long sentences need more peers than short ones.</p>\n  <div class=\"controls\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Series to show\">\n    <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"k-all\" checked> All rows (95% CI band)</label>\n    <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"k-T1\"> Shortest tercile</label>\n    <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"k-T2\"> Middle tercile</label>\n    <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"k-T3\" checked> Longest tercile</label>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"chart\" id=\"k-chart\" role=\"figure\" aria-label=\"AUROC against number of peer families\"></div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"k-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============ TRY IT ============ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <div class=\"kicker\">Try it</div>\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Rebuild the score, drop peers, move the threshold</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose q\">What if the peer pool were smaller, or the flagging threshold stricter?</p>\n  <p class=\"prose\">This recomputes the shared-signature consensus score for every translation in your browser, from the recorded Z3 equivalence classes: peers are the other-family translations of the same sentence that parsed; off-signature peers count as disagreeing. With every family in the pool the recomputation reproduces the recorded score exactly. Untick families to shrink the pool; drag the threshold to trade <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"e\">endorsement</button> for <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"d\">divergence</button>.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <fieldset style=\"border:0;padding:0;margin:0 0 8px\">\n      <legend class=\"small\" style=\"font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px\">Peer families in the pool</legend>\n      <div class=\"controls\" id=\"fam-box\" style=\"margin:0\"></div>\n    </fieldset>\n    <div class=\"rangebox\">\n      <label for=\"thr\">Flag a translation when its consensus score is at least</label>\n      <input type=\"range\" id=\"thr\" min=\"0\" max=\"1\" step=\"0.01\" value=\"0.5\">\n      <output id=\"thr-out\" for=\"thr\">0.50</output>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"small\" id=\"try-check\"></p>\n    <div class=\"stats\" id=\"try-stats\"></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"try-chart\" role=\"figure\" aria-label=\"Distribution of consensus scores for errors and correct translations, with the threshold\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--err)\"></i>Errors</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--cor)\"></i>Correct</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--ink);width:3px\"></i>Threshold</span></div>\n  </div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"try-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============ WHERE IT FAILS ============ -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <div class=\"kicker\">Where it fails</div>\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Long sentences, free vocabulary, renamed predicates</h2>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-ed\">Divergence grows with length when vocabulary is free</h3>\n  <p class=\"prose q\">Why does the free-vocabulary score weaken on the sentences where gold-free evaluation matters most?</p>\n  <p class=\"prose\">Split each population into word-length terciles and count the two ways a majority vote of peers goes wrong: errors the majority endorses (<i>e</i>) and correct translations the majority rejects (<i>d</i>). At a binary threshold the AUROC equals 1 &minus; (<i>e</i> + <i>d</i>)/2.</p>\n  <div class=\"controls\">\n    <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Vocabulary condition\" id=\"ed-reg\">\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"radio\" aria-checked=\"false\" data-v=\"SIG\" tabindex=\"-1\">Shared signature (R_COMP)</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"radio\" aria-checked=\"true\" data-v=\"E\">Free vocabulary (dev set E)</button>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"chart\" id=\"ed-chart\" role=\"figure\" aria-label=\"Endorsement and divergence rates by length tercile\"></div>\n  <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--err)\"></i><i>e</i>: errors endorsed</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i><i>d</i>: correct translations rejected</span></div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"ed-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:44px\" id=\"h-ren\">The rename tradeoff</h3>\n  <p class=\"prose q\">What happens when a correct formula is rewritten without changing its meaning?</p>\n  <p class=\"prose\">Under free vocabulary the <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"aligner\">predicate aligner</button> must match names across families. Rename the predicates of a correct formula and a name-based aligner loses its peers. The name-free variant <code>c_nf</code> is immune, but it cannot see errors that consist of a wrong predicate name.</p>\n  <div class=\"controls\">\n    <label for=\"ren-rw\">Meaning-preserving rewrite</label>\n    <select id=\"ren-rw\"></select>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"chart\" id=\"ren-chart\" role=\"figure\" aria-label=\"False-alarm rate per metric on the selected rewrite\"></div>\n  <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Consensus variants</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>Disguised judge</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--ink);width:3px\"></i>False-alarm rate before the rewrite</span></div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"ren-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:44px\">Consensus false alarms, one click away</h3>\n  <p class=\"prose\" id=\"fa-text\"></p>\n  <p><button type=\"button\" class=\"btn primary\" id=\"fa-open\">Open consensus false alarms in the item browser</button></p>\n\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:36px\">What the paper does not show</h3>\n  <ul class=\"prose limits\">\n    <li><b>Confirmation is incomplete.</b> Held-out confirmation was budget-stopped. On the one testable stratum of the fresh set (short ProverQA sentences), consensus ties a local Qwen-8B judge (&Delta; = +0.003 [&minus;0.042, +0.052]); on 42 L25 items with 7 correct ones from 3 sentences it falls to 0.443.</li>\n    <li><b>Shared-signature scope.</b> The 0.954 result uses templated sentences and a supplied vocabulary. It does not extend to translators that choose their own predicate names.</li>\n    <li><b>Development overlap.</b> R_COMP-SIG later served as development data for aligner tuning, so the numbers on set E are not independent of it.</li>\n    <li><b>Provisional free-vocabulary labels.</b> R_COMP FREE uses ERROR_CERT versus MAPPED, where MAPPED is an upper bound on correct; the labelling gate failed twice. The two-auditor subset gives &Delta; = +0.105 with a CI that barely excludes zero.</li>\n    <li><b>Label dependence.</b> Set E labels come from a three-person panel with imperfect agreement; part of the advantage could reflect panel biases.</li>\n    <li><b>Cost.</b> With nine peers the amortised consensus cost per candidate is about 19 times a single cheap judge call.</li>\n    <li><b>Error typing.</b> Outside a shared vocabulary, typing the error is near chance: 0.123 accuracy on E, below the judge (0.326) and the peer-medoid baseline (0.328).</li>\n    <li><b>Domain.</b> English to FOL only, from MALLS, ProverQA and R_COMP. Other formalisms and languages are untested.</li>\n  </ul>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<!-- ============ FOOTER ============ -->\n<footer id=\"notes\" aria-labelledby=\"h-notes\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-notes\">Links, data and glossary</h2>\n  <div class=\"links\" style=\"margin-bottom:26px\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_cNhUBrixEdz7\">Code repository</a>\n  </div>\n  <h3>Data provenance</h3>\n  <p class=\"small muted\">Each view reads one of the JSON blocks embedded in this page. Each block was produced by a script that reads the run's output files and keeps only the fields the views use; no value was typed by hand.</p>\n  <ul class=\"prov\" id=\"prov\"></ul>\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:28px\">Glossary</h3>\n  <dl id=\"glossary\">\n    <dt>First-order logic (FOL)</dt><dd id=\"def-fol\">The target language of the translation: formulas with quantifiers (&forall;, &exist;), predicates, connectives and negation. NL&rarr;FOL translation turns a natural-language sentence into such a formula.</dd>\n    <dt>Z3</dt><dd id=\"def-z3\">The SMT solver used to check whether two formulas are logically equivalent. Equivalent formulas fall in the same class.</dd>\n    <dt>Consensus score (c_score)</dt><dd id=\"def-cscore\">c_score(c, s) = 1 &minus; (1/k) &Sigma; 1[equiv(c, p<sub>i</sub>)]: the share of the k cross-family peer translations of sentence s that are not equivalent to candidate c. Higher means more likely an error.</dd>\n    <dt>Shared signature (SIG)</dt><dd id=\"def-sig\">All translators receive the same supplied predicate vocabulary, so equivalence is a direct Z3 check after case-insensitive symbol normalisation, and labels come from Z3 alone.</dd>\n    <dt>Free vocabulary</dt><dd id=\"def-free\">Each translator chooses its own predicate names, so comparing two formulas first needs a predicate-name aligner (c_score_align).</dd>\n    <dt>AUROC</dt><dd id=\"def-auroc\">The probability that a randomly chosen wrong translation receives a higher score than a randomly chosen correct one. 0.5 is chance, 1.0 is perfect separation.</dd>\n    <dt>Within-template / stratified AUROC</dt><dd id=\"def-strat\">AUROC that compares error and correct items only inside the same stratum (sentence template on R_COMP, source stratum on set E), removing confounds from stratum-level base rates.</dd>\n    <dt>Disguised judge</dt><dd id=\"def-disg\">An LLM judge that reads the sentence and candidate with nonce predicate names, to control for memorisation of known benchmarks. The original-view judge sees the real names.</dd>\n    <dt>Endorsement e</dt><dd id=\"def-e\">The fraction of ERROR items endorsed by the peer majority: the false negatives of consensus.</dd>\n    <dt>Divergence d</dt><dd id=\"def-d\">The fraction of CORRECT items that diverge from the peer majority: the false positives (false alarms) of consensus.</dd>\n    <dt>Predicate aligner</dt><dd id=\"def-aligner\">Under free vocabulary, maps predicate names across formulas using structural cost, text-anchor cost and truth-value signatures, then declares a pair equivalent if any of the cheapest bijections gives a Z3-verified equivalence.</dd>\n    <dt>R_COMP</dt><dd id=\"def-rcomp\">Long templated sentences (at least 25 words, 4 to 5 conditions, one unless / except / provided-that / only-if clause) built from a verified lexicon, with weak and strong reference readings trusted by construction.</dd>\n    <dt>Weak and strong reading</dt><dd id=\"def-reading\">The two accepted readings of an exception clause in R_COMP. For \"A is B unless C\" the weak reading is A &and; &not;C &rarr; B; the strong reading is A &rarr; (B &harr; &not;C).</dd>\n    <dt>Development set E</dt><dd id=\"def-dsE\">8,507 candidate translations of 700 MALLS and ProverQA sentences. Its primary population R_AB, where both panellists agree, has 2,686 items (1,822 ERROR / 864 CORRECT, 292 sentences).</dd>\n    <dt>Nonce and synonym renames</dt><dd id=\"def-rename\">Meaning-preserving rewrites of a correct formula: NONCE replaces predicate names with random nonsense names, SYN with WordNet synonyms. hc=sum(len(re.findall(r'\b'+h+r'\b',low)) for h in hedges); print('hedges',hc,'per1000',hc/n*1000)
sents=[s for s in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+',txt) if len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+",s))>=3]
L=[len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9.,%+-]+",s)) for s in sents]
q=statistics.quantiles(L,n=4); print('sent n',len(L),'IQR',q[2]-q[0],q)
EOF
. venv/bin/activate && python register.py
```

### [177] ASSISTANT · 2026-09-25 03:12:23 UTC

```
I've built `interactive.html` in the paper folder and linked it from `index.html`. Every chart and count on it is calculated in the browser from the run's own per-item records, and it reproduces the paper's headline numbers exactly:

| Condition | Consensus | Disguised judge | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shared signature (R_COMP) | 0.954 | 0.587 | +0.367 |
| Free vocabulary, same sentences | 0.801 | 0.584 | +0.217 |
| Free vocabulary, dev set E | 0.741 | 0.642 | +0.099 |

It also reproduces the other numbers I checked: the error and false-alarm rates by sentence length (0.292→0.040 and 0.305→0.913), the rename false-alarm table and the family-count curve.

I opened it in the headless browser at 390px and 1440px and used every control, with real clicks and taps. The console shows no errors or warnings, the page never scrolls sideways, and a term's definition stays open after you click it.

**What's on the page:**
- **The finding:** tabs switch between the three conditions in the table, with a length or stratum filter. A bar chart compares consensus with every judge and baseline, and the three big numbers and the summary sentence update with the selection.
- **How it works:** a five-step walk-through of one real sentence, with three sentences to choose from. It goes from the sentence, to the ten translations, to Z3's grouping of equivalent formulas, to one candidate's score, and finally to the check against the reference readings. You can move with the buttons, the stage markers or the arrow keys.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - A browser over all 2,210 shared-signature translations. You can search, filter to errors, disagreements, consensus false alarms or judge misses, and sort. Each item shows the sentence, the candidate, both reference readings and the scores side by side.
  - A per-template comparison of consensus against each judge.
  - A chart of how many peer families the score needs.
- **Try it:** the page recomputes the consensus score for every translation from the run's recorded Z3 groupings. With all families included, all 2,140 scored rows match the recorded scores. Tick families off to shrink the peer pool, or drag the threshold, and the accuracy numbers and histogram update.
- **Where it fails:** error and false-alarm rates by sentence length (flat with a shared vocabulary, rising sharply without one), false alarms after meaning-preserving renames, and a button that opens the 414 consensus false alarms in the browser. The paper's limitations follow.
- **Footer:** all three links, a data-provenance list, the citation from `index.html` and a glossary.

**Things you might not expect:**
- **No paper figures on the page.** All three are data plots that the page draws live from the data.
- **Judge comparison in "Try it".** The judge gives its maximum score to a large share of correct translations. So at strict thresholds, the judge operating point with the closest false-alarm rate often catches 0% of errors. The page states that false-alarm rate next to the number rather than hiding it.
- **Other edits.** `index.html` gained only the two "Explore the website" links, in the header and the footer. I also added one row for the new page to `README.md`, plus a short "Restoring removed files" section saying nothing needs restoring. The manifest stays empty because nothing in the folder is over 10 MB.

I didn't publish the page anywhere, since your pipeline publishes the folder. The extraction and build scripts are in my scratchpad, not the published folder.

Files are in the paper folder:
- `interactive.html`
- `index.html`
- `README.md`
- `.terminal_claude_agent_struct_out.json`
